blocking_notes: Do not put old LeWM CV numbers and BridgeEngine pi0.7 numbers on one axis until they have been evaluated on the same fixed split.
LeWM_testbed/scripts/evaluate_boring3d.py currently creates a per-seed random 90/10 split; it must be adapted or bypassed for the preregistered fixed-split evaluator.

The 100-episode HDF5 cache contains VDA depth and CoTracker3 tracks. It does not contain the pilot-only mask/centroid/shape fields, so the first shared 100-episode comparison should be A/B/D/E plus pi0.7 families.

conditions.mechanism: no auxiliary prediction target and no pi0.7 conditioning
conditions.name: baseline
conditions.notes: There are two historical baseline implementations; the preregistered run must report which evaluator produced the plotted baseline.
conditions.source: LeWM A baseline and BridgeEngine baseline must be evaluated on one fixed split before plotting together

conditions.mechanism: Video-Depth-Anything depth as an auxiliary prediction target
conditions.name: cv_B_depth_aux
conditions.notes: Native LeWM aux-head condition B: predicts 56x56 depth with aux weight 0.1.

conditions.mechanism: CoTracker3 point displacements as an auxiliary prediction target
conditions.name: cv_D_tracks_aux
conditions.notes: Native LeWM aux-head condition D: predicts 400x2 point-track displacements with aux weight 0.1.

conditions.mechanism: VDA depth and CoTracker3 tracks as auxiliary prediction targets
conditions.name: cv_E_depth_tracks_aux
conditions.notes: Native LeWM aux-head condition E: combines depth and track aux heads, each weight 0.1.

conditions.mechanism: subtask text as a conditioning input
conditions.name: pi07_rich_text
conditions.notes: Uses Kevin-reviewed boundaries where available and VLM boundaries elsewhere.

conditions.mechanism: subtask text plus speed, quality, mistake, and control metadata as conditioning inputs
conditions.name: pi07_rich_text_metadata
conditions.notes: Uses Kevin-calibrated quality scores in the human-gold snapshot.

conditions.mechanism: subtask text, metadata, and end-of-segment subgoal frame as conditioning inputs
conditions.name: pi07_full_metadata_subgoal
conditions.notes: Current POC has the full-stack subgoal family, not an isolated subgoal-only family.

mechanism_disclosure: LeWM CV signals are native auxiliary prediction targets. BridgeEngine pi0.7 signals are conditioning inputs. The planned plot is an annotation-strategy comparison, not a pure signal-content comparison.

estimate_notes: LeWM CV estimates scale cached N=100 elapsed times linearly by N.
BridgeEngine pi0.7 estimate scales the existing human-gold 2-seed scale curve to the requested seed count.
Evaluation and fixed-split adapter development time are not included.

stop_rule: This command is planning-only. Launch the unified grid only after Kevin approves the seed count and the fixed-split evaluator path.

bridgeengine_pi07_current.note: This is the current pi0.7-conditioning adapter path. It is not the same mechanism as the LeWM aux-head CV conditions.
